selected_evidence.requirement: Encrypted volume created and mounted at /srv/secure (initial provisioning)
selected_evidence.summary: LUKS2 luksFormat/luksOpen on loop device, ext4 mkfs, mount at /srv/secure with marker file written; verification output shows active LUKS2 mapping and mount, plus OpenRC service installed and added to default runlevel.

Manually tore down the volume (umount, luksClose, losetup -d) and ran rc-service secure-volume start from a clean state, proving the boot-time unlock/mount logic works and data survives, before relying on an actual reboot.
Captured boot_id 0f0b1874-9005-4066-867a-2883386e7f35, active LUKS2 status, mount, marker file presence, and runlevel enablement prior to reboot.
sudo -n reboot issued in background with ack captured (REBOOT_ACK_SENT) before the exec stream closed due to the node going down.

selected_evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving a real restart occurred
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id read as 3db78b50-5bf7-4850-b272-6fc6ae01e487, differing from the pre-restart 0f0b1874-9005-4066-867a-2883386e7f35, confirming an actual reboot (not just service restart).

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: encrypted volume auto-unlocked/mounted and cluster/data healthy
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, /srv/secure is mounted from /dev/mapper/secure_vol (LUKS2, active), the secure-volume OpenRC service shows started and enabled in default runlevel, the pre-existing marker file survived, and a new write to the volume succeeded — all without manual intervention.

commands.command:
cat > /tmp/setup-secure-volume.sh <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "STEP: install cryptsetup"
apk add --no-cache cryptsetup >/tmp/apk-install.log 2>&1
cryptsetup --version

echo "STEP: prepare directories"
install -d -m 0700 /var/lib/secure-volume
install -d -m 0700 /etc/luks-keys
install -d -m 0755 /srv/secure

IMG=/var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img
KEY=/etc/luks-keys/secure.key
MAPNAME=secure_vol

echo "STEP: create backing file (512M)"
if [ ! -f "$IMG" ]; then
  dd if=/dev/zero of="$IMG" bs=1M count=512 status=none
fi
chmod 600 "$IMG"

echo "STEP: generate keyfile"
if [ ! -f "$KEY" ]; then
  dd if=/dev/urandom of="$KEY" bs=4096 count=1 status=none
  chmod 400 "$KEY"
fi

echo "STEP: attach loop device"
LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j "$IMG" | cut -d: -f1)
if [ -z "$LOOPDEV" ]; then
  LOOPDEV=$(losetup -f)
  losetup "$LOOPDEV" "$IMG"
fi
echo "loop device: $LOOPDEV"

echo "STEP: luksFormat (idempotent check)"
if ! cryptsetup isLuks "$LOOPDEV"; then
  cryptsetup luksFormat --batch-mode --type luks2 "$LOOPDEV" "$KEY"
fi

echo "STEP: luksOpen"
if [ ! -e "/dev/mapper/$MAPNAME" ]; then
  cryptsetup luksOpen "$LOOPDEV" "$MAPNAME" --key-file "$KEY"
fi

echo "STEP: mkfs if needed"
FSTYPE=$(blkid -o value -s TYPE "/dev/mapper/$MAPNAME" || true)
if [ -z "$FSTYPE" ]; then
  mkfs.ext4 -q -L secure "/dev/mapper/$MAPNAME"
fi

echo "STEP: mount"
mountpoint -q /srv/secure || mount "/dev/mapper/$MAPNAME" /srv/secure
touch /srv/secure/.provisioned-by-antrieb
df -h /srv/secure

echo "STEP: write OpenRC service"
cat > /etc/init.d/secure-volume <<'SVC_EOF'
#!/sbin/openrc-run
description="Unlock and mount encrypted /srv/secure volume"

IMG=/var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img
KEY=/etc/luks-keys/secure.key
MAPNAME=secure_vol
MNT=/srv/secure

depend() {
	need localmount
	before sshd
	after modules
}

start() {
	ebegin "Unlocking and mounting encrypted volume ${MNT}"
	LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j "${IMG}" | cut -d: -f1)
	if [ -z "${LOOPDEV}" ]; then
		LOOPDEV=$(losetup -f)
		losetup "${LOOPDEV}" "${IMG}"
	fi
	if [ ! -e "/dev/mapper/${MAPNAME}" ]; then
		cryptsetup luksOpen "${LOOPDEV}" "${MAPNAME}" --key-file "${KEY}"
	fi
	mountpoint -q "${MNT}" || mount "/dev/mapper/${MAPNAME}" "${MNT}"
	eend $?
}

stop() {
	ebegin "Unmounting encrypted volume ${MNT}"
	umount "${MNT}" 2>/dev/null || true
	cryptsetup luksClose "${MAPNAME}" 2>/dev/null || true
	eend 0
}
SVC_EOF
chmod +x /etc/init.d/secure-volume

echo "STEP: enable service in default runlevel"
rc-update add secure-volume default

echo "STEP: verification - current state"
rc-update show default | grep secure-volume
cryptsetup status "$MAPNAME" | head -5
mount | grep secure_vol
cat /srv/secure/.provisioned-by-antrieb && echo "FILE_OK"

echo "DONE"
ANTRIEB_EOF
sudo -n sh /tmp/setup-secure-volume.sh

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: simulate pre-boot state (manual teardown)"
sudo -n umount /srv/secure
sudo -n cryptsetup luksClose secure_vol
LOOPDEV=$(sudo -n losetup -j /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img | cut -d: -f1)
sudo -n losetup -d "$LOOPDEV"
losetup -a | grep secure || echo "NO_LOOP_ATTACHED_OK"
mount | grep secure_vol || echo "NOT_MOUNTED_OK"
sudo -n rc-service secure-volume stop 2>&1 || true

echo "STEP: run service start from clean state (simulates boot)"
sudo -n rc-service secure-volume start
mount | grep secure_vol
cryptsetup status secure_vol | head -3
cat /srv/secure/.provisioned-by-antrieb && echo "DATA_SURVIVED_OK"
